methodologyAndLimits: Full 163-country publisher Overall Results table independently parsed, PDF pages 8–9, with wrapped country names resolved from adjacent lines; 161 app entries, excluding Taiwan and Kosovo.
Source numeric ranks preserved even when rounded scores coincide; rank movement sign is positive toward rank 1, which means greater terrorism impact, NOT improvement.
Score-band categories checked against publisher legend; 2026 is publication year, while the report principally analyses 2025 activity and the index uses a multi-year weighted window.
Zero score/No Impact is an index category, not proof that a country has no security risk or no history of terrorism.
